proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke's failed-save branch destroys the target outright and is not representable as damage, condition, or exile without lying about the rule.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.target_type_conditional_disadvantage
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation needs a one-shot save modifier keyed by the target's creature type, which the current save_gate shape cannot express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save.

proposed_widenings.name: passive_item_contact_hazard
proposed_widenings.justification: The talisman automatically damages external creatures that touch it and repeats the damage while they keep holding or carrying it; the current passive item operation surface has no trigger+attachment shape for this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

notes: No content Dhall/JSON/trace was authored. The item kind and composite magic-item family exist, but producing a trace would require false encoding of the destroy-on-fail branch and the automatic touch/carry hazard.
